description_text: Technical Lead About Sand Sand Technologies is a global Physical AI company using data and AI to make critical industries work better. We partner with governments cities and enterprises to improve how essential systems operate across healthcare water energy telecommunications and infrastructure. Our work delivers proven real-world impact. We have built AI systems that help manage London s water supply supported telecom network planning across hundreds of cities and developed digital healthcare platforms serving tens of millions of people across Africa. From intelligent command centers to AI-powered infrastructure platforms we help organizations sense analyze and act in complex environments. Our people are ambitious curious and relentlessly practical. Our teams work alongside clients in the field solving hard problems and deploying solutions that last. With colleagues across Africa Europe the UK and the US we operate across the full stack - from research and engineering to deployment and capability building. Our mission is simple to harness AI to solve humanity s most pressing challenges. About the role The primary responsibility for this technical leadership role is the delivery of production-level intelligent solutions. The role encompasses client management and enabling of shared client interests. Working alongside the Delivery Lead and Senior Business Analyst you will provide technical input to scoping discussions and drive delivery of agreed outputs by a cross-functional squad. This is a player-manager role. You will be expected to contribute directly to technical delivery alongside leading the squad. What you ll do Lead technical delivery across the full solution stack from data ingestion and processing pipelines through to API and application layers ensuring quality reliability and security throughout. Act as the primary technical point of contact for the client building strong relationships with their engineering and operations teams and representing Sand s technical approach with confidence. Lead and mentor a cross-functional squad of data engineers data scientists and software engineers setting standards and providing direction through code reviews and architectural decisions. Work closely with the Solution Architect to translate design into day-to-day delivery decisions managing technical risk and escalating where needed. Contribute hands-on to delivery alongside leading the team maintaining a strong understanding of the codebase and platform at all times. Who you are 5+ years in a technical role with at least 2 years in a technical lead or equivalent player-manager capacity proven track record leading technical delivery not just contributing to it ideally in a client-facing or consulting delivery model. Able to work across both software and data engineering comfortable reviewing and unblocking React/TypeScript frontend work Python FastAPI/Django or .NET backend work and Azure data pipeline work even if you don t write every line yourself. Hands-on experience delivering on Microsoft Azure specifically Event Hubs Azure Data Lake Azure Databricks Azure Digital Twins AKS/containers and Azure AI services. Comfortable being the primary technical face of Sand to a client in a regulated critical-infrastructure environment able to translate technical trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and hold your own with client architects. A track record of setting engineering standards and mentoring engineers through delivery not just managing tickets. Able to work autonomously in a small internationally distributed team while staying tightly coordinated with a Solution Architect and wider delivery organisation. Relevant Bachelor s degree in computer science engineering or a related field. Tech stack Azure Event Hubs Data Lake Databricks Azure Digital Twins AKS Azure AI services Backend Python FastAPI / Django .NET Frontend React TypeScript Advantageous Experience in water utilities or other regulated/asset-intensive sectors particularly operational technology OT SCADA integration or control-room environments. Familiarity with environmental compliance pollution event management or network asset monitoring in a utility context. Microsoft certifications AZ-204 AZ-400 AI-102 Databricks or other relevant cloud/data credentials. Knowledge of data governance quality frameworks and security practices in regulated environments particularly within an Azure landing zone. How we work Due to the highly collaborative and internationally distributed nature of our work successful candidates must be comfortable operating in small teams while contributing to larger globally coordinated efforts. A strong sense of ownership self-motivation and discipline in maintaining clear and consistent communication through virtual collaboration tools and video conferencing is essential.
